full: A 10-second widescreen (16:9) silent clip. A small neighbourhood barber shop on a quiet weekday afternoon: one black leather chair in front of a wide mirror with round bulbs, a worn wooden counter with clippers, combs and a talc brush, a striped pole outside the front window, warm tungsten light inside and soft daylight from the window. Marcus, the barber, mid-forties, shaved head, grey beard, black apron over a white t-shirt. Dev, the customer, early twenties, in the chair with a black cape, short dark hair being finished into a fade. Marcus finishes the fade on Dev's right side with the clippers, steps back, tilts his head to check the line, then picks up the talc brush and dusts Dev's neck. Dev looks into the mirror. End on Marcus lifting the cape at Dev's shoulders, about to take it off.
